hero.lead: ARIS brings fixtures, appointments, assessments, VAR decisions, licences and match fees into one platform — for every federation, every referee, every match.

pitch.label: Animation: a referee holds the diagonal while ARIS tracks the match

federations.title: Built for {count} African federations
federations.lead: Each federation works in its own language, currency and time zone, on its own competitions.

modules.title: The whole refereeing cycle, in one place
modules.lead: Eight modules that talk to each other: an appointment feeds match fees, an observer report feeds the rankings, a conflict of interest is caught before the appointment.

calendar.title: Fixtures & calendar
calendar.body: Create, validate and publish fixtures, send call-ups, reschedule with a recorded reason.

designations.title: Crew appointments
designations.body: A live board that checks neutrality, qualification, rest, availability and conflicts of interest before they cost a match.

assessments.title: Assessments & observers
assessments.body: Reports on a weighted grid: drafts, filing, corrections with a reason, release to the referee.

decisions.title: VAR decision engine
decisions.body: Every key decision timed, VAR reviews included, to measure accuracy match after match.

development.title: Development & licences
development.body: Licences, fitness tests and courses tracked, with alerts before every deadline.

discipline.title: Discipline
discipline.body: Incidents, cases and suspensions handled with a complete, verifiable history.

finance.title: Match fees & finance
finance.body: Fee scales per country and currency, payment runs, advances and deductions without arithmetic slips.

analytics.title: Analytics & rankings
analytics.body: ARPS, heatmaps, comparisons and trends to spot the referees ready for the next level.

workflow.title: From fixture list to report, entered once
workflow.lead: Data typed in once follows the match all the way through.

plan.title: Plan
plan.body: The federation publishes its national calendar.

appoint.title: Appoint
appoint.body: ARIS proposes crews that are available and conflict-free.

officiate.title: Officiate
officiate.body: Call-ups, result and key decisions are recorded.

assess.title: Assess
assess.body: The observer files a report on the official grid.

develop.title: Develop
develop.body: Rankings and progress update; match fees are generated in one click.

roles.title: Everyone sees what concerns them — and nothing else

admin.title: Super admin
admin.body: The referees department runs the whole continent.

federation.title: Federation
federation.body: Each federation runs its national refereeing.
federation.p3: Match fees in its own currency

referee.title: Referee
referee.body: A personal space, on phone or desktop.

security.title: Sensitive data, treated that way
security.lead: Medical records, sanctions, payments: ARIS is built so every piece of information stays where it belongs.

scope.title: Walled off by country
scope.body: A federation never sees another federation's officials or files.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.body: Every change is timestamped, attributed and kept with its previous state.

sessions.title: Protected access
sessions.body: Hashed passwords, signed sessions, rate-limited sign-in attempts.

edge.title: Fast everywhere
edge.body: Served from Cloudflare's global network, close to every stadium.

languages.title: One platform, four languages
languages.lead: French, English, Spanish and German — everyone picks their own, and the reports follow.

cta.title: Ready to take the field?
cta.lead: Sign in with the account issued by your federation or by the referees department.

footer.tagline: Designed in Africa, for African refereeing.
